$comment: SPEC section 5 report model (ADR-0004). Structure only: rules R4 to R15 in tools/sitecheck.py (records) add what a structural schema cannot say, so this schema alone under-describes a valid record (ADR-0004 part 2). Keywords are limited to the subset tools/sitecheck.py implements (ADR-0002 part 4, amended by ADR-0004 part 2).
title: Report record front matter
description: Front matter of content/reports/<slug>.md: one report per name a candidate sees. Only date and params are allowed at the top level, so nothing in a record can set a title, URL, alias, draft state or build option (ADR-0004 part 4).

date.description: Publication date (YYYY-MM-DD): the sort order, the feed's published date and the JSON-LD datePublished. A future date is not built.

name.description: The name a candidate sees, every dot written [.]. It renders only through the record-name partial, and the slug derives from it (R4) except for persona records.

aliases.description: Other spellings of the name, shown as "Also seen as".

name_type.description: What kind of name this is.

state.description: The D6 state of the name: name_abused (used without the owner's involvement) or front (no real party found behind it). Every name has one (ADR-0004 part 1).

state_basis.description: What was checked to reach the state, shown as "What was checked".

items.description: One check, as a short factual sentence.

hide_name.description: Persona records only (R6): true hides the name and aliases from the page, the title, the feed and every index without changing the URL (ADR-0004 part 5).

campaign.description: The campaign family that used this name, only when a cited source of this record names the name or lists one of its artifacts. Absent means unattributed (ADR-0004 part 6).

slug.description: Slug of a campaign record in content/campaigns/ (R7).

source.description: The id of the source of this record that links the name to the campaign (R7).

basis.description: named: the source names this name. artifact: the source lists one of its artifacts, given in artifact (R7).

artifact.description: With basis artifact only: one of this record's declared artifact values, exactly as stored (R7).

related.description: Slugs of other report records shown as "Related names" (R7).

summary.description: Short factual summary: the lead, the meta description and the feed summary.

evidence.description: Summary of the evidence that was reviewed, never raw personal data (D7).

first_seen.description: Date the name was first seen in use (YYYY-MM-DD).

last_seen.description: Date the name was last seen in use, not before first_seen (R8).

last_reviewed.description: Date the evidence was last reviewed, not before last_seen (R8). The D7 label and the JSON-LD lastReviewed.

independent_reports.description: Number of independent reports the moderator reviewed. 0 only when the record cites at least one source (R9, ADR-0004 part 12).

artifacts.description: The attacker artifacts, every one defanged (D8). At least one entry overall (R10).

domains.description: Domains, every dot written [.]. Only these are compared with source hosts (R15), so every attacker-owned host is declared here.

urls.description: URLs, with hxxp or hxxps and every dot in the host written [.].

ips.description: IPv4 addresses in dotted form, every dot written [.].

emails.description: Email addresses, every dot in the host written [.].

items.description: One email address, for example hr[@]meeting[.]example.
One file name, for example Setup[.]zip.

handles.description: Accounts on messaging and social platforms.

name.description: The package name, every dot written [.], for example socket[.]io.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hashes of files. The page links only the lookups in listed_on, never a file (ADR-0004 part 9).

value.description: The SHA-256 as 64 lowercase hex digits.

file_name.description: The file name the hash was seen with, every dot written [.].

listed_on.description: The lookup services the moderator found the hash on, at least one.

sources.description: Cited sources. Optional when independent_reports is at least 1 (R9).

items.description: One cited source: a vendor report, an advisory or an article. Its url is the one live link a record carries (D8); every other field is record text (R11).

id.description: Identifier of the source within this record, referenced by params.campaign.source and params.attribution[].source (R7). Unique per record.

title.description: Title of the source as published, with every dotted name defanged (R11).

publisher.description: Publisher of the source, with every dotted name defanged or written undotted (R11), for example Doctor Web.

url.description: Live https link to the source. Its host must not equal, be a subdomain of or be a parent of any declared artifacts.domains value of any report (R15), and it is never an IP literal in integer, hex, octal or short form (R12).
